python3 -m pytest -q
python3 - <<'PY'
from unittest.mock import Mock
from larder.reminders import remind

send_sms = Mock()
send_email = Mock()
remind('+351123456789', 'member@example.com', 'tomorrow at 12:00', send_sms, send_email)
send_email.assert_called_once_with('member@example.com', 'Your pantry order is ready for pickup tomorrow at 12:00.')
send_sms.assert_not_called()
print('Reminder delivery verified: email sent, SMS not called.')
PY
